answer: If the downstream modifier cannot be expected to know the original model's training compute value and cannot estimate it, the threshold should be replaced with a third of the threshold for a model being presumed to have high-impact capabilities (currently 10^25 FLOP) if the original model is a general-purpose AI model with systemic risk. Otherwise, it should be replaced with a third of the threshold for a model being presumed to be a general-purpose AI model (currently 10^23 FLOP).
